name: Tables have descriptions
description: Every table has a description.
fix: Add a /// description line above the table in its TMDL file.

name: Visible columns have descriptions
description: Every visible column has a description.
fix: Add a /// description line above the column, saying what it holds and its unit.

name: Measures have descriptions
description: Every measure has a description.
fix: Add a /// description line above the measure, saying what it calculates.

name: Provide format string for measures
description: Every measure has a format string.
fix: Set a formatString on the measure, for example #,0 or \$#,0.

name: Date tables are marked as date tables
description: Date tables are marked as date tables and have a key date column.
fix: Mark the table as a date table (dataCategory: Time) and set isKey on its date column.

name: Hide foreign keys
description: Foreign key columns are hidden.
fix: Set isHidden on the key column; people filter with the dimension instead.

name: Tables use Dim/Fact PascalCase names
description: Table names are PascalCase with a Dim or Fact prefix.
fix: Rename the table to PascalCase with a Dim or Fact prefix, and update the report visuals that use it.

name: Columns use PascalCase names
description: Column names are PascalCase.
fix: Rename the column to PascalCase, and update any measures and visuals that reference it.

name: Measures use Title Case names
description: Measure names are Title Case with spaces.
fix: Rename the measure to Title Case with spaces, and update visuals that use it.

name: Column names don't repeat the table name
description: No column name starts with its table name.
fix: Drop the table name from the start of the column name.

name: Check bi-directional relationships
description: Relationships filter in one direction only.
fix: Set the relationship to filter in one direction, and use CROSSFILTER in a measure where both are needed.

name: Avoid implicit measures on fact columns
description: Visible numeric fact columns have no default aggregation; use a measure instead.
fix: Set summarizeBy: none on the column and use an explicit measure instead.

name: Column references should be fully qualified
description: Column references in DAX are fully qualified, as Table[Column].
fix: Write column references as Table[Column].

name: Measure references should be unqualified
description: Measure references in DAX are unqualified, as [Measure] without a table name.
fix: Write measure references as [Measure], without the table name.

name: No two measures should have the same definition
description: No two measures have the same definition.
fix: Keep one of the measures and point visuals at it, or change one definition if they should differ.

name: Use the DIVIDE function for division
description: Division uses DIVIDE instead of the / operator.
fix: Replace a / b with DIVIDE(a, b), which handles division by zero.

name: Avoid using the IFERROR function
description: IFERROR is not used.
fix: Remove IFERROR and handle the error case directly, for example with DIVIDE or IF.

name: Measures should not be direct references of other measures
description: A measure is not just a reference to another measure.
fix: Delete the copy and use the original measure, or give this one its own logic.

name: Don't use EVALUATEANDLOG in production
description: EVALUATEANDLOG is not used.
fix: Remove EVALUATEANDLOG once debugging is finished.

name: Use TREATAS instead of INTERSECT
description: Virtual relationships use TREATAS instead of INTERSECT.
fix: Replace INTERSECT with TREATAS for the virtual relationship.

name: Inactive relationships that are never activated
description: Inactive relationships are activated by USERELATIONSHIP somewhere.
fix: Use the relationship in a measure with USERELATIONSHIP, or delete it.

name: Data columns must have a source column
description: Data columns have a source column.
fix: Set sourceColumn on the column to the matching source field.

name: Measures must have an expression
description: Measures have an expression.
fix: Give the measure a DAX expression, or delete it.

name: Relationship columns should be the same data type
description: Both columns of a relationship have the same data type.
fix: Change one key column so both sides of the relationship have the same data type.

name: Avoid invalid characters in names and descriptions
description: Names and descriptions contain no control characters.
fix: Remove control characters from the name or description.

name: Ensure tables have relationships
description: Every table has at least one relationship.
fix: Relate the table to the model, or delete it if it is not needed.

name: Remove unnecessary columns
description: Hidden columns are used by a relationship, a sort, or a DAX expression.
fix: Delete the column from the table and its source query; it is hidden and nothing uses it.

name: Remove unnecessary measures
description: Hidden measures are referenced by another expression.
fix: Delete the measure; it is hidden and nothing references it.

name: Objects should not start or end with a space
description: Names do not start or end with a space.
fix: Remove the leading or trailing space from the name.

name: Object names must not contain special characters
description: Names contain no tabs or line breaks.
fix: Remove tabs and line breaks from the name.

name: First letter of objects must be capitalised
description: Table, measure and calculated column names start with a capital letter.
fix: Start the name with a capital letter.

name: Partition name should match table name
description: A table with one partition names it after the table.
fix: Rename the partition to match the table name.

name: Do not use floating point data types
description: Numeric columns use fixed decimal or whole number types, not floating point (double).
fix: Change the column to decimal (fixed decimal) or int64.

name: Model should have a date table
description: The model has a table marked as a date table.
fix: Add a date table and mark it as the model's date table.

name: Remove auto-date tables
description: There are no auto date/time tables.
fix: Turn off auto date/time in Power BI options and use the model's date table.

name: Consider a star schema instead of a snowflake
description: No table is on both the one and many side of relationships (star schema, not snowflake).
fix: Merge the outer table into its dimension so the model stays a star.

name: Avoid excessive bi-directional or many-to-many relationships
description: No more than 30% of relationships are bidirectional or many-to-many.
fix: Change bidirectional or many-to-many relationships to single direction where you can.

name: Minimise Power Query transformations
description: Power Query avoids joins, grouping, sorting, pivots and native queries.
fix: Move joins, grouping and sorting to the source, or to a view in the database.

name: Relationship columns should be whole numbers
description: Relationship columns are whole numbers.
fix: Use an integer surrogate key for the relationship.

name: Mark primary keys
description: Columns on the one side of a relationship are marked as the table's key (date tables excepted).
fix: Set isKey on the column on the one side of the relationship.

name: Hide fact table columns
description: Numeric columns aggregated by a measure are hidden, so people use the measure.
fix: Hide the column; people use the measure that aggregates it instead.

name: Format percentages with one decimal
description: Percentage measures use the format #,0.0%;-#,0.0%;#,0.0%.
fix: Set the measure's formatString to #,0.0%;-#,0.0%;#,0.0%.

name: Format whole numbers with thousands separators
description: Measures that are not currency or percentages use #,0 or #,0.0.
fix: Set the formatString to #,0, or #,0.0 if a decimal place is needed.

name: Add data category for columns
description: Country, continent, city, latitude and longitude columns have a data category.
fix: Set the column's dataCategory (Country, City, Continent, Latitude or Longitude) so maps work.

name: Month (as a string) must be sorted
description: Month name text columns have a sort-by column.
fix: Set sortByColumn to the month number column.
